relationships.subject: Nrf2
relationships.evidence_quote: nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) and its downstream regulated protein heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1)

key_findings: Review: Nrf2 and downstream HO-1 provide antioxidant, anti-inflammatory and anti-apoptotic protection relevant to intervertebral disc degeneration.
